articles.title: South African airline defends dramatic low-level flyby before rugby union clash
articles.summary: Cape Town stunt sparks major debate over safety risksAirlink insist flyby conducted according to regulationsA pre-game stunt involving two passenger jets flying dramatically low over a stadium in South Africa drew huge cheers from the estimated crowd of around 56,000 people, but also sparked a major debate over safety risks. articles.title: Nepal flooding deaths surpass 900 as needs climb
articles.summary: The confirmed death toll from Nepal’s catastrophic floods has surged to 903, with more than 4,200 still missing as rescue crews and humanitarian workers battle blocked highways to reach the hardest-hit areas, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Monday. Nepal flooding deaths surpass 900 as needs climb.

articles.title: Morocco not to blame for Ceuta border breach, says Spanish PM
articles.summary: Pedro Sánchez says two countries are cooperating after mass incursion by 70,000 people into north African enclave Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has insisted there was no evidence to suggest the Moroccan government was behind last month’s massive border crossing into Ceuta. As many as 141 people are thought to have died trying to enter the Spanish enclave at the end of July.

articles.title: US Conducts Fresh Strikes On Iran, Seen As 'Signal' To Tehran On Hormuz
articles.summary: US forces struck two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz after the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) was observed preparing to launch rockets carrying sea mines into the vital waterway, a US official confirmed to RFE/RL. articles.title: Ukrainian Officials Blamed For 'Negligence' After Deadly Strikes
articles.summary: With at least 38 people killed in Russian air attacks on the Kyiv region, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said "terrible negligence" was a factor in the high death toll. Ukrainian authorities have pledged to investigate why a weapons storage depot was located close to a populated area. Ukrainian Officials Blamed for 'Negligence' After Deadly Strikes.

articles.title: ‘The lake is our life’: Protecting a shared lifeline in Uganda
articles.summary: On the shores of Nkondo, in Uganda’s Kikuube district, the day begins before sunrise. Fishers enter the lake to fish, while families around Lake Albert rely on its waters for food, income and daily survival. ‘The lake is our life’: Protecting a shared lifeline in Uganda.

articles.title: Zelenskyy Blasts 'Negligence' As Ukraine Mourns Dozens Killed In Russian Strike

Zelenskyy Blasts 'Negligence' As Ukraine Mourns Dozens Killed In Russian Strike.

articles.title: Was it a mistake for 99 Colombian guerrillas to lay down their arms?
articles.summary: ‘Total peace’ plan of previous government led only 99 of Colombia’s 30,000 armed combatants to disarm, but new president Abelardo De la Espriella opposes peace agreementsIn mid-June, 99 guerrilla fighters were flown by helicopter to a small settlement in a rural area of southern Colombia where they lined up and, one by one, handed their weapons to government officials: rifles, pistols, machine gun.

articles.title: Egyptian queen’s 673-diamond necklace stolen in Vienna smash-and-grab raid
articles.summary: Police hunt two suspects after historic 200-carat piece is snatched from Austrian museum during opening hoursAustrian police are hunting two men alleged to have stolen a 200-carat platinum necklace encrusted with 673 diamonds that was on loan to a museum in Vienna and once belonged to Egyptian royalty. articles.title: Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says
articles.summary: Damaged roads, disrupted services and ongoing military activity continue to put civilians at risk in south Lebanon as strikes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah continue, according to the UN’s peacekeeping mission in the country (UNIFIL). UN warns of growing civilian risks as military activity continues. Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says.

articles.title: Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire
articles.summary: A July roadmap sponsored by the Board of Peace has failed to overcome obstacles that have mired Gaza’s ceasefire deal ten months on. A mix of sustained pressure and diplomatic guarantees is needed to break the logjam and centre Palestinian agency in the strip's recovery. Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire.

articles.title: Curbing Reprisals in Syria
articles.summary: Fuelled by wartime grievances, mob attacks and other forms of retribution threaten Syria’s transition. Damascus has done too little to deter such acts. It should ensure visible legal consequences for violence and broaden locally rooted policing to rebuild trust among vulnerable communities. Curbing Reprisals in Syria.

articles.title: On Our Radar
articles.summary: scans conflicts and crises around the globe every week and features some of the hotspots Crisis Group’s analysts are closely watching. Whether an under-reported trend or a headline-grabbing development, our field experts explain why it matters or what should be done. On Our Radar.

articles.title: Assessing the New U.S. Initiative for Libya
articles.summary: Washington is negotiating an accord that would piece Libya’s divided national institutions back together. But its political aspects have sown fierce controversy. Rather than risk the country’s tenuous peace, U. S. mediators should seek broader buy-in, focusing on budgetary and military issues in the interim. Assessing the New U. Initiative for Libya.

SCO सम्मेलन में PM मोदी ने जिनपिंग से लिया हालचाल, पास खड़े शहबाज को देखा तक नहीं।

articles.title: नेपाल का वो शहर जहां से भारत का ‘चिकन नेक’ झांकता है चीन, उड़ा दिए 300 मिलियन डॉलर
articles.summary: नेपाल का सीमावर्ती शहर काकरभिट्टा भारत के बिल्कुल करीब है. चीन ने यहां 300 मिलियन डॉलर के एशियन हाईवे कॉरिडोर प्रोजेक्ट पर कब्जा जमा लिया है. चीनी कंपनियां भारतीय सीमा के पास पुलों और सड़कों का जाल बिछा रही हैं. चीन की इस चाल का जवाब देने के लिए भारतीय रेलवे ने भी मास्टर प्लान तैयार कर लिया है. नेपाल का वो शहर जहां से भारत का ‘चिकन नेक’ झांकता है चीन, उड़ा दिए 300 मिलियन डॉलर।

articles.title: एक घर से 23 शव, 4000 लापता, नेपाल में बाढ़ के बाद अब महामारी का साया
articles.summary: नेपाल में आई विनाशकारी बाढ़ को एक हफ्ता बीत चुका है, लेकिन हालात अब भी बेहद गंभीर बने हुए हैं। मलबे में दबे लोगों को खोजने का काम लगातार जारी है। रेस्क्यू में जुटी टीमों के मुताबिक अब तक करीब 962 शव बरामद किए जा चुके हैं, जबकि करीब चार हजार लोगों का अभी तक कोई पता नहीं चल पाया है। आज नुवाकोट में रेस्क्यू ऑपरेशन के दौरान बचाव दल को खौफनाक मंजर का सामना करना पड़ा।
